title: ED communication practice — medication routine
summary: Fictional communication example. Explore concerns and clarify the patient's medication routine. Draft: no diagnosis or treatment advice; qualified clinical review required before learners use it.
opening: I'm worried, and I don't want to be judged. Can we talk about what has been difficult lately?
fallback_answer: Could you ask about my concerns or my medication routine? I don't have that information.

facts.label: Main concern
facts.text: The fictional patient is worried about being judged when discussing a medication routine.
facts.patient_answer: I'm worried about being judged when we discuss my medication routine.

facts.label: Medication routine
facts.text: The fictional patient missed several doses because the routine was hard to remember. No medicine or diagnosis is specified.
facts.patient_answer: Actually, I missed several doses. The routine was hard to remember, and I was embarrassed to tell you.
facts.nondisclosure_answer: I think I've been following the routine.

facts.label: Lab availability
facts.text: No lab results were authored for this communication example.

artifacts.title: Synthetic communication note
artifacts.body: Practice respectful clarification of the patient's routine. This is not a real chart, diagnosis, prescription, or clinical recommendation.

objectives.label: Invite the patient's concerns
objectives.guidance: Invite the patient to explain what worries them; do not infer inner empathy from phrasing alone.
objectives.next_question: What has been worrying you most?

objectives.label: Clarify the medication routine respectfully
objectives.guidance: Use a concrete, nonjudgmental question about routines rather than accusing the patient of dishonesty.
objectives.next_question: Could you walk me through yesterday and what made your medication routine difficult?

author_note: Unreviewed synthetic demonstration only. Created to exercise authoring/disclosure mechanics, not derived from a clinical dataset. No faculty clinical approval or validation is established.
